Dear Chift team,

I'm applying for the GTM Engineer role. Your mission to become Europe's financial integration leader and the chance to build the revenue engine from scratch immediately caught my attention.

In my current roles, I've been building systems rather than just running them. I designed and built baverok.com from scratch, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and a free site-check enquiry flow. At mirook.com, I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably improved search health. I use Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content, and audits, and I've integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools. I also built an Android app live on Google Play and use Python to automate repetitive work.

I'm eager to bring this builder mentality to Chift, industrializing your revenue engine and making every AE more effective with AI. I'd love to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Chift team,

I'm writing to apply for the GTM Engineer position. Chift's ambition to become the European leader in financial integration, and the opportunity to build the revenue engine from the ground up, is exactly the kind of challenge I'm looking for.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've developed a builder mentality: I'd rather spend a week building a system than two weeks running it by hand. For baverok.com, I designed and built the entire site myself in WordPress/Elementor, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, accessible markup, and a free site-check enquiry flow. At mirook.com, I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. I use Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content, and audits, and I've integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools. I also built an Android app live on Google Play and use Python to automate repetitive tasks.

While my experience is more marketing-ops than pure RevOps, I'm comfortable with the modern growth stack and pick up new tools fast. I've worked with HubSpot (certified in Content Marketing), Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs, and I'm eager to master Clay, LaGrowthMachine, and Make/n8n. I thrive in fast-paced environments and love the startup ecosystem.

I'm fluent in English, with Turkish as my native language and Dutch at B1 writing level, which I'm actively improving. I'd love to bring my technical background, AI-native approach, and drive to Chift to help industrialize your revenue engine and make every AE more effective.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
